name: Century Extrusions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Century Extrusions Ltd manufactures Aluminum Extruded Products, Power Transmission and Distribution Line Hardware[1]
keyPoints:
Busines Overview:[1]
Company produces aluminium extrusions in 
all types of soft, medium, and high-strength 
 alloys from the complete range of 1000 to 
 7000 series of alloys.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 20.1 days to 11.5 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.5% over last 3 years.
